answer: When one mind wears many masks, every mask's stake ripples out from the same funding wallet and the same invite edge. The protocol builds a correlation graph: identities sharing funding paths, inference-latency fingerprints, or vouch edges snap together like polyps on a reef and get billed as a single actor. So an attacker cannot mint a fresh mask at dawn for free, each added identity now demands genuinely independent capital and an unlinked origin, turning the cost of a sybil swarm from near-zero into real money that scales linearly with the number of masks.
